content.title: Arizona routs Arkansas to make first March Madness Elite 8 since 2015
content.text: Updated March 26, 2026, 11:04 p.m. MTThe Arizona Wildcats played their third game of the 2026 NCAA Tournament against Arkansas on Thursday, March 28, 2026.And it went well for the Wildcats.Arizona, the No. 1 seed in the West Region, defeated Arkansas, the No. 4 seed, with an impressive performance to make the Elite Eight of the NCAA Tournament.What was the score of the Arizona vs Arkansas game? Who stood out? What's next?Look back at our updates from the game, which was being played at SAP Center in San Jose, California.Watch Arizona vs Arkansas on FUBO (free trial) What was the Arizona vs Arkansas score?The Arizona vs Arkansas score in the Sweet 16 of March Madness was Arizona 109, Arkansas 88. Arizona defeats Arkansas to make first Elite 8 since 2015The Arizona Wildcats have made their first Elite Eight since 2015 with a 109-88 win over Arkansas in the Sweet 16 of the NCAA Tournament on Thursday, March 26, at SAP Center in San Jose, California.The win was Tommy Lloyd's first Sweet 16 win since taking over as Arizona's coach. He was 0-3 in his previous trips to the regional semifinals.Arizona, the No. 1 seed in the West Region, will face No. 2 seed Purdue on Sunday, March 28, for a bid in the Final Four.Purdue beat No. 11 Texas in the Sweet 16, 79-77.Arizona dominated against No. 4 Arkansas. The Wildcats had six players in double figures, led by Brayden Burries' 23 points. Koa Peat had 21.Arizona shot 64% from the field in the game.The Wildcats improved to 35-2 on the season with the win.Arkansas ended the season with a 28-9 record. Darius Acuff Jr. led the Razorbacks with 28 points.Final score: Arizona 109, Arkansas 88 Arizona survives Arkansas' run in second halfThat 7-0 run didn't last for Arkansas.Arizona was able to withstand Arkansas' run, and pad its lead in the second half against the Razorbacks.It helps that Arizona has hit 27-36 free-throws in this game. Arkansas has been called for 24 fouls.The Elite Eight is close for Arizona.Score: Arizona 102, Arkansas 77 (4:57 left in second half) Arkansas goes on 7-0 run vs ArizonaDid we speak too soon? Arkansas has gone on a quick 7-0 run on Arizona to pull within 17.There is still 7:31 left in this game.Darius Acuff Jr. is up to 23 points for the Razorbacks, who are fighting with everything they have to get this game closer.Score: Arizona 89, Arkansas 72 (7:31 left in second half) Arizona Wildcats appear headed to Elite 8There is still 8:52 left in this game, but the Arizona Wildcats appear headed to the Elite Eight.Arizona leads Arkansas 89-65.They are shooting 67% from the field. They have outscored Arkansas in the second half, 35-22.It looks like it would take a huge collapse for Arizona not to advance to its first Elite Eight since 2015.Score: Arizona 89, Arkansas 65 (8:52 left in second half) Arizona rolling against Arkansas in second halfArizona is rolling against Arkansas in the second half.Arizona's lead was as high as 78-57.The Wildcats have been able to get some easy buckets in transition and are shooting 66% from the field in this game (29-for-44).Brayden Burries has been a big catalyst for Arizona. He's up to a team-high 17 for the Wildcats on 6-for-9 shooting.Darius Acuff Jr. is now at 19 points for Arkansas, but the Razorbacks have been outscored in this half, 24-19.Score: Arizona 78, Arkansas 62 (11:38 left in second half) Arizona builds lead early in second half vs ArkansasThe Arizona Wildcats did not come out flat in the second half.Arizona continues to have its way offensively against Arkansas, as the Wildcats have put up 13 quick points against the Razorbacks.Arizona had a 65-47 lead at one point on Arkansas. They currently lead 67-53.Every Arizona starter now has at least nine points, with Koa Peat leading the way with 13.Darius Acuff Jr. is up to 15 points for Arkansas.Score: Arizona 67, Arkansas 53 (15:54 left in second half) Arizona takes 54-43 lead into half against Arkansas in Sweet 16The Arizona Wildcats are looking to make their first Elite Eight since 2015.They are off to a good start midway through their Sweet 16 game against Arkansas.Arizona holds a 54-43 lead on Arkansas after 20 minutes at SAP Center in San Jose, California.The winner of the game advances to face No. 2 seed Purdue in the Elite Eight West Region final on Sunday, March 28.Ivan Kharchenkov leads the Wildcats with 11 points. Every Arizona starter has at least seven points, as does Tobe Awaka off the bench.Darius Acuff Jr. has 11 points to lead Arkansas.Arizona shot an impressive 18-for-28 from the field in the first half. Arkansas was 15-for-32.Can the Wildcats close out the Razorbacks in the second half?Halftime score: Arizona 54, Arkansas 43 Arkansas heating up vs Arizona late in first halfArizona had built the lead to 15, but Arkansas scored a quick four points to pull back within 11 and Tommy Lloyd decided to call a time out with 3:01 left in the first half.Arkansas, after a rough start shooting in this game, is now 13-for-28 from the field.Nick Pringle has provided a big boost off the bench for the Razorbacks. He is 3-for-3 from the field in seven minutes, with a huge highlight reel dunk.Tobe Awaka has been huge for Arizona off the bench, with seven points in eight minutes and a couple of big dunks.Score: Arizona 46, Arkansas 35 (3:01 left in first half) Arizona Wildcats leading by 13 against Arkansas RazorbacksArizona has a game-high 13-point lead on Arkansas with just under four minutes left in the first half.This game has already seen 22 free throws. Arizona is 11-for-13. Arkansas is 7-for-9.Arkansas needs Darius Acuff Jr. to start scoring to have a shot at getting back in this game.Score: Arizona 44, Arkansas 31 (3:59 left in first half) Arizona maintains lead vs Arkansas in first halfThe Wildcats hold an 11-point lead over the Razorbacks with 5:47 left in the first half.One reason why?The Razorbacks are 2-of-10 from 3 in this game. They shoot about 39% from 3 on the season.Arkansas is 9-for-22 from the field.Darius Acuff Jr., who had seven quick points for Arkansas, still has seven points. He is 2-for-6 from the field.Arizona is shooting 14-for-21 from the field.How's this for balanced scoring? Every Arizona starter has five, six or seven points. Tobe Awaka also has five points off the bench for the Wildcats.Score: Arizona 38, Arkansas 27 (5:47 left in first half) Arizona off to hot start shooting vs Arkansas in Sweet 16The Wildcats are off to a very hot start shooting against the Razorbacks.Arizona has gone 10-for-13 from the field to start this game. It is 3-for-3 from 3-point range.That will do.Arkansas is shooting 5-for-13 from the field and 1-for-5 from 3-point range.Arizona has extended its lead to 25-15 with the hot-shooting start.Score: Arizona 25, Arkansas 15 (11:25 left in first half) Tobe Awaka has early highlight dunk for Arizona vs ArkansasTobe Awaka can rebound.He can also put back rebounds.The Arizona senior forward provided an early highlight with an impressive put back dunk against Arkansas. Arizona, Arkansas start fast in March Madness Sweet 16 gameThis game could be a track meet. Both the Razorbacks and Wildcats can play fast, and they are playing fast at the start of this regional semifinal.The pace is very quick at the SAP Center in San Jose, California, and right now it has benefitted Arizona.The Wildcats are off to a 16-11 lead at the first break in action.Brayden Burries leads the Wildcats with five points. Darius Acuff Jr. has a game-high seven points for the Razorbacks.Buckle up. This game could be very fun.Score: Arizona 16, Arkansas 11 (13:45 left in first half) What time will Arizona vs Arkansas game start?The Arizona vs Arkansas game will start at approximately 7:06 p.m. MST (10:06 p.m. ET). Arizona vs Arkansas delayed due to lengthy Purdue vs Texas gameThe Purdue vs Texas game just ended in San Jose, California, pushing back the start of the Arizona vs Arkansas game.The CBS broadcast indicated that the Wildcats vs Razorbacks game was currently scheduled to start at 7:06 p.m. MST (10:06 p.m. ET). It was originally scheduled to start at 6:45 p.m. MST.The game can be seen on CBS and streamed on FUBO, which offers a free trial. Who does Arizona vs Arkansas winner play in Elite 8?The winner of the Arkansas vs Arizona Sweet 16 game today will take on Purdue in the Elite Eight.Purdue, the No. 2 seed in the West Region, beat Texas is the No. 11 seed, with a Trey Kaufman-Renn tip-in with less than a second left to advance to the regional final, 79-77.That was the first game of the Sweet 16 West Region doubleheader at SAP Center in San Jose, California, with Arizona vs Arkansas to follow. What's at stake in Arizona vs Arkansas Sweet 16 game tonightThe Arizona Wildcats have appeared in four Final Fours in men's basketball over the years, and won one national championship, but the team is in the midst of some droughts in the NCAA Tournament.It hasn't been to the Elite Eight since 2015. It hasn't been to the Final Four since it lost to Duke in the national title game in 2001.Coach Tommy Lloyd is 0-for-3 in the Sweet 16 since taking over as the Wildcats' coach.Will Arizona make the regional final for the first time since 2015, and for the first time under Tommy Lloyd, tonight?Or will Arkansas, looking to return to the Elite Eight for the first time since 2022, break through with a regional finals appearance under John Calipari?The Razorbacks haven't been to the Final Four since they lost to UCLA in the national title game in 1995, a year after they won their national championship.Will they get a step closer to returning to the Final Four?We don't have to wait long to find out. Tommy Lloyd North Carolina speculation a distraction for Arizona ahead of game vs Arkansas?The speculation about Arizona coach Tommy Lloyd being a potential candidate for the North Carolina job continues to swirl.Will it be a distraction for Arizona tonight? We're about to find out.Catch up on the latest on the situation with our recent stories:Arizona AD reveals important detail about path to keeping Tommy LloydArizona coach Tommy Lloyd shuts down North Carolina questionNorth Carolina basketball coach speculation with Arizona's Tommy LloydNCAA basketball analysts see UA coach Tommy Lloyd as a top fit for UNC Iowa first team into Elite Eight after win over NebraskaNo. 9 seed Iowa is in the Elite Eight after beating No. 4 Nebraska in the Sweet 16 today.Iowa upset No. 1 Florida in the second round.The Hawkeyes beat the Cornhuskers, 77-71, with an impressive end-of-game run.They await the winner of the South Region's other Sweet 16 game tonight, No. 2 Houston vs No. 3 Illinois. Burries vs. Acuff, the fight for a top-five draft spotOne game doesn’t make a difference, generally, but this head-to-head matchup of elite freshman guards might have an effect on the NBA draft.Arizona's Brayden Burries is a little more versatile and plays a little better defense, but Darius Acuff is an offensive force who has drawn significant interest from NBA scouts.It's one of many matchups to watch in the Arizona vs Arkansas game tonight.
